extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome Web Store and extension management

extDescription.message: Essentiële tools voor werk en privé
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome Web Store

headerByline.description: Byline below the extension name in the popup header, crediting the website (rendered as a link)

settings.description: Accessible label for the settings menu button in the popup header, and of the menu

settingsTheme.description: Heading of the color theme options in the settings menu

themeLight.description: Theme menu option for the light color theme

themeDark.description: Theme menu option for the dark color theme

themeSystem.description: Theme menu option for following the operating system's color theme

settingsOpenTools.description: Heading of the settings menu options for where a click on a tool opens it

openToolsInTab.description: Settings menu option: a click on a tool opens it on the website in a new browser tab (the default)

openToolsInPopup.description: Settings menu option: a click on a tool opens it inside the extension popup

tabOnline.description: Label for the online search tab

searchPlaceholderOnline.description: Placeholder text in the search input when on the online tab

searchPlaceholderBookmarks.description: Placeholder text in the search input when on the bookmarks tab

searchAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the search input

clearSearch.description: Accessible label for the button that clears the search input

searchErrorUnknown.description: Error shown when a tool search fails without a more specific message

statusLoading.description: Status text shown while bookmarks are loading

emptyOnlinePrompt.message: Typ een zoekopdracht om online naar tools te zoeken.
emptyOnlinePrompt.description: Placeholder message in the online tab before searching

emptyNoToolsFound.message: Geen tools gevonden voor je zoekopdracht.
emptyNoToolsFound.description: Message shown when a search returns no matching tools

emptyBookmarksNone.description: Message shown when the user has no bookmarks

emptyBookmarksNoMatch.message: Geen bladwijzers komen overeen met je filter.
emptyBookmarksNoMatch.description: Message shown when the bookmark filter matches nothing

emptyBookmarksCta.message: Zoek online naar tools en voeg ze toe aan je bladwijzers.
emptyBookmarksCta.description: Call-to-action shown below the empty bookmarks message

showMore.description: Button to expand a tool description

showLess.description: Button to collapse a tool description

removeBookmark.description: Accessible label for the remove-bookmark button

addBookmark.description: Accessible label for the add-bookmark button

back.description: Accessible label for the button that closes the tool open in the popup and goes back to the list

openInNewTab.description: Accessible label for the button that opens the tool on the website in a new browser tab

popupCloseWarning.message: Door beperkingen van extensies verdwijnen de gegevens die je invult zodra de pop-up sluit. $LINK$ om je gegevens te bewaren.
popupCloseWarning.description: Warning above a tool opened inside the extension popup. First sentence: what the user enters disappears when the popup closes, because of what browser extensions can do; second: opening the tool in a new tab keeps it, with $LINK$ standing for that action as a link (popupCloseWarningLink). Simple everyday words

link.example: Open deze tool in een nieuw tabblad

popupCloseWarningLink.message: Open deze tool in een nieuw tabblad
popupCloseWarningLink.description: Link inside the warning above a tool opened in the popup (it replaces $LINK$ in popupCloseWarning, so it must fit that sentence): opens the tool on the website in a new browser tab

dontShowAgain.description: Button in the warning above a tool opened in the popup that turns the warning off for good

syncConnectCta.description: Button label to start the RapidToolSet sync connection flow

syncConnecting.description: Button label shown while the RapidToolSet auth flow is in progress

syncConnected.description: Status text shown when connected but not yet synced

syncNeverSynced.description: Status text shown when connected but a sync hasn't run yet

syncEmptyTitle.message: Koppel je RapidToolSet-account om je bladwijzers op al je apparaten te synchroniseren
syncEmptyTitle.description: Title shown on the sync tab before connecting

syncSyncing.description: Status text shown while a sync is in progress

syncedAgo.description: Status text showing how long ago bookmarks were last synced

syncNow.description: Accessible label for the manual sync button

syncDisconnect.description: Accessible label for the disconnect-from-RapidToolSet button

syncedBookmarkDescription.description: Placeholder description for a bookmark pulled from RapidToolSet with no local metadata

syncErrorCancelled.description: Error shown when the user closes the RapidToolSet auth window without completing it

syncErrorDenied.description: Error shown when the user clicks Deny on the RapidToolSet consent screen

syncErrorNoToken.description: Error shown when the auth flow completes without a token

syncErrorExpired.message: Je RapidToolSet-sessie is verlopen. Maak opnieuw verbinding.
syncErrorExpired.description: Error shown when the stored token is rejected as invalid or revoked

syncErrorRequestFailed.description: Error shown when a sync API request fails

syncErrorUnknown.description: Error shown when a sync fails without a more specific message

syncErrorConnectFailed.description: Error shown when connecting a RapidToolSet account fails without a more specific message

syncAccountName.description: Label for the disabled field showing the connected RapidToolSet account's name

syncAccountEmail.description: Label for the disabled field showing the connected RapidToolSet account's email
